rule: No two hard sessions of these pairs on consecutive days (glycolytic, run quality, long run, heavy lower)
summary: Hard-easy sequencing is standard coaching practice; this run found no trial testing specific pairs. Kept as a scheduling heuristic; overrides on athlete request are fine and should be watched in review.

sources.note: Bishop 2008 review: recovery between workouts is a planned part of training
Ristolainen 2014 (446 top endurance athletes): <2 rest days/wk had 5.2x overuse-injury risk (retrospective)
